newsitem.title: UK: Prudential buys 0.7 mln Northern shrs.
newsitem.headline: Prudential buys 0.7 mln Northern shrs.

text.p: Takeover target Northern Electric Plc said on Tuesday that insurer Prudential Corp had bought just over 709,000 shares in Northern Electric at 6.50 stg per share.
The announcement followed speculation that Prudential was buying Northern shares in the market in an effort to thwart a bid for Northern by CE Electric of the U.S.
CE Electric, which is controlled by CalEnergy, said earlier on Tuesday that unconfirmed reports of the purchases were "extraordinary."

Northern's fate is perched on a knife's edge ahead of the extended 1300 GMT deadline for acceptances of CE Electric's offer. Sources told Reuters earlier that Northern needed to win back only 200,000 shares to defeat the CE Electric bid.
Sources close to the negotiations told Reuters the shares had been purchased from people who had already provisionally accepted CE Electric's offer.
On Monday morning CE said it had received acceptances from shareholders representing just over 50 percent of Northern's issued share capital, enough for its bid to scrape home.
